messages:
claire: Heads-up	we need a concise release note for the samples + broken-anchor fixes we pushed. Req: 2-sentence summary, one migration snippet (JS), and one known-issue line about analytics webhook URL changes. Target: site cut tomorrow AM.
oz: I started a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1522 - added a short blurb and a samples section under /releases/samples-and-links. PTAL.
ben: Noted an awkward anchor break in the SDK examples page: old anchors like #js-snippet-embeddings now redirect but the redirect loses query params; added a redirect note in the PR.
maya: Pls include a tiny JS code snippet showing how to parse the new samples layout (they wrapped examples in an envelope). One-liner preferred.
claire: Good call. Also add a troubleshooting note: analytics webhook endpoint changed from /v1/events -> /v2/ingest; customers using the old endpoint will receive 410. Short known-issue ok.
oz: Added JS snippet to PR:
```js
// parse new samples envelope
const vec = resp.data[0].embedding || resp.data[0].embedding_vector;
```
oz: Added known-issue pill: "Webhook endpoint changed to /v2/ingest; old endpoints return 410. Update integrations."
ben: I pushed a tiny redirect test to the PR that preserves query params; docs-ci: can you run the anchor-check?
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1522--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/samples-and-links) - anchor and redirect checks running. :white_check_mark:
maya: Small nit: change "envelope" to "response envelope" for clarity. Also add a one-line curl snippet for the webhook check so support can triage quickly.
oz: Updated wording and added curl healthcheck: 
```bash
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/v2/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'
```
ben: I left a comment to ensure the migration note references SDK >=0.9.0 helper methods that flatten sample envelopes.
claire: Can reviewers react with :shipit: if OK? Plan: merge after docs-ci is green and cut deploy at 08:00.
maya: :shipit: small grammar nit fixed in PR.
ben: :shipit: redirects pass locally for me.
docs-ci: Final build green. Merge complete. Site deploy scheduled 08:00.
claire: Thanks team, I'll add release bullet to the release-notes doc and ping product for the announcement. Closing thread. :tada:
